channel.title: Liberia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Liberia, every source cited.

item.title: Liberian senator demands port operators explain delays
item.description: Senator Amara Konneh wants port operators and government agencies summoned to explain protracted delays and high costs impacting businesses.

item.title: Liberia cancer survivors walk for early detection
item.description: Survivors shared recovery stories at the Liberia Cancer Resource Initiative's annual breast cancer awareness walk in Monrovia.

item.title: NPP chairman moves to strip Jewel Howard-Taylor of party leadership
item.description: Party delegates will elect a 'political leader' instead of a standard bearer at the December convention.

item.title: China donates 304 farm machines to Liberia
item.description: Liberia aims to cultivate 50,000 hectares of farmland with the new equipment.

item.title: India offers Liberia 140 training slots
item.description: Liberian professionals will receive fully funded training in various disciplines for the 2026-2027 financial year.
